nodes.label: Student Subject (Leadership Representative)
nodes.source_location: centered head-and-shoulders framing, upper two-thirds of frame
nodes.rationale: Square 1:1 head-and-shoulders framing with direct eye contact and a neutral light wall places the whole emphasis on the person's face, the conventional pattern for an avatar/profile tile where the image is cropped into a small circle or rounded card.

nodes.label: STI College Uniform Polo
nodes.source_location: subject's torso, light gray short-sleeve polo with navy collar
nodes.rationale: Institutional uniform is kept in frame rather than cropped to a tight face shot so the portrait reads as an official school-affiliated representative, not a casual photo.

nodes.label: STI College Lanyard
nodes.source_location: hanging across the chest, black strap with yellow lettering reading 'STI COLLEGE'
nodes.rationale: The lanyard text acts as an in-image identity label, reinforcing the school brand without needing a caption overlay.

nodes.label: STI College Embroidered Crest
nodes.source_location: left chest of the polo, embroidered circular seal with tower motif

nodes.label: Plain Light Gray Backdrop
nodes.source_location: background filling the frame behind the subject
nodes.rationale: A seamless near-white wall with soft even lighting removes visual noise so the subject's silhouette stays legible when the asset is scaled down into a small UI avatar.

hyperedges.label: Institutional Identity Signifiers on the Student Subject
hyperedges.rationale: Uniform, lanyard text, and embroidered crest stack three redundant school marks on one person so the affiliation survives downscaling and cropping.

hyperedges.label: Avatar-Ready Portrait Composition
hyperedges.rationale: Centered subject, square crop, and clear backdrop together form a drop-in avatar image for a leader/profile card.
